A `failed` repository is replaced by the new attempt (an SSH one keeps its Deploy key).

path.description: Relative to the Repository root, with `/` separators.

message.description: The commit message, 1 to 2,000 characters; the first line is the subject. Author and committer are never taken from the request.

baseCommit.description: The Draft's base commit, as the page showed it.

version.description: The Draft's `version`, as the page showed it; another version is a conflict.

commit.description: The commit now on the Integration branch of the Repository.

name.description: Unique together with `source`: a built-in and a refused folder can share a name.

description.description: Null for an agent that is not usable.

provider.description: Null for an agent that is not usable.

model.description: Null for an agent that is not usable.

source.description: A built-in Default agent, or a folder of the definitions Repository.

usable.description: False while the definition has problems.

skills.description: The skill names the definition lists, as written; empty when none and for a front matter that cannot be read.

path.description: The file or folder the problem is about, relative to the agent folder.

key.description: The front matter key, when the problem is about one.

message.description: Fixed wording per code; never a value or file content.

commit.description: The commit of the definitions Repository the agents were read at; null when none was.

repository.description: Null when no definitions Repository is connected.

truncated.description: True when more agent folders exist than are listed.

text.description: Plain text, not Markdown. The instructions of an agent come after.

baseRules.description: The rules every Run gets before the instructions of its agent. Read-only.

name.description: Unique together with `source`: a built-in and a refused folder can share a name.

description.description: Null for an agent that is not usable.

provider.description: Null for an agent that is not usable.

model.description: Null for an agent that is not usable.

source.description: A built-in Default agent, or a folder of the definitions Repository.

usable.description: False while the definition has problems.

skills.description: The skill names the definition lists, as written; empty when none and for a front matter that cannot be read.

instructions.description: Plain text, never Markdown or HTML to render; empty for a built-in agent.

files.description: Every file of the agent folder with its size in bytes; empty for a built-in.

commit.description: The commit of the definitions Repository the agents were read at; null when none was.

repository.description: Null when no definitions Repository is connected.

provider.description: The Provider follows from the agent.

model.description: The model the agent names; `default` is the CLI own.

agents.description: The usable agents: the built-in Default agents, then the definitions agents.

preselected.description: The name of the agent to offer first, always one of `agents`.

preselectedReason.description: Why the default agent of the project is not the preselected one; null when it is, or none is named.

name.description: The name of the skill folder, as found; it may not be a valid name.

description.description: Null for a skill that is not valid.

valid.description: False while the skill has problems.

path.description: The file or folder the problem is about, relative to the skill folder.

key.description: The front matter key, when the problem is about one.

message.description: Fixed wording per code; never a value or file content.

commit.description: The commit of the definitions Repository the agents were read at; null when none was.

repository.description: Null when no definitions Repository is connected.

truncated.description: True when more skill folders exist than are listed.

commit.description: The commit of the definitions Repository the agents were read at; null when none was.

repository.description: Null when no definitions Repository is connected.

name.description: The name of the skill folder, as found; it may not be a valid name.

description.description: Null for a skill that is not valid.

valid.description: False while the skill has problems.

instructions.description: Plain text, never Markdown or HTML to render; empty for an invalid skill.

files.description: Every file of the skill folder with its size in bytes.

usedBy.description: The names of the agents at the same commit whose definition lists this skill, valid or not, sorted.

agent.description: The agent to start with, by name. Absent: the Default agent of `provider`.

provider.description: Alone, it means the Default agent of this Provider. With an `agent`, it must be the agent's Provider.

source.description: A built-in Default agent, or a folder.

commit.description: The definitions Repository commit the agent was read at; null for a built-in one.

model.description: The model the definition named; `default` is the CLI own.

instructions.description: A copy of the definition instructions, plain text. Single-Run answers only; lists leave it out.

models.description: The models an agent may name for this provider; `default` is the CLI own.

composeFile.description: Relative POSIX path of the Compose file in the Integration branch, at most 255 characters: no leading `/` or `./`, no `..`, backslash or empty segment.

service.description: The Compose service the Preview routes to.

port.description: The port of that service the Preview routes to.
